title: StickADV 0.2 merged 版本在 Cardputer-ADV 上的 usb_dwc_hal_init 断言归因（issue #278 补充）

execution.environment: macOS arm64; read-only attribution of an existing firmware-review job; Device Service native QEMU (m5cardputeradv)

checks.name: firmware_identity
checks.detail: 931888 bytes and SHA-256 match the declared artifact

checks.name: image_and_partition_parse
checks.detail: 8 MiB merged image; bootloader, partition table and app0 valid; app1 empty; partitions fit

checks.detail: panic at usb_dwc_hal_init GSNPSID assertion before any IDF banner

checks.name: usb_otg_model_presence

checks.name: duplicate_issue_check

evidence.note: derived summary; hashes of raw evidence listed inside

notes: Root cause is the missing board-level DWC2/USB-OTG model for Cardputer-ADV, not the firmware or the merged packaging.
The same assertion and the first three backtrace PCs match the app-only sample already tracked in issue 278.
No emulator code was changed, nothing was pushed to the emulator repository, and no issue was closed.
This round's qom-diff reported 'device does not advertise qom' and was not used as evidence.
